message.content:
Here’s a classic set of ingredients you’ll typically find on a chocolate‑cake shopping list:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for ~8–9 inch round) |
|------------|--------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ½ cups (≈190 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (≈400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (≈75 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 tsp (≈5 g) |
| Salt | ¼ tsp (≈1 g) |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Milk | 1 cup (240 ml) – whole or 2% works best |
| Vegetable oil or melted butter | ⅔ cup (160 ml) |
| Vanilla extract | 1 tsp (≈5 ml) |
| Boiling water or hot espresso/coffee | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras:**  
* A splash of strong brewed coffee or espresso instead of plain boiling water to deepen flavor.  
* Optional “buttercream” frosting or ganache made from powdered sugar and heavy cream if you’re topping it up later.  

These amounts give you a moist, rich chocolate cake ready for your favorite frosting!
